---
title: "simstim policy allow"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Add an allow rule at one policy layer.

```text
simstim policy allow [net] <target> [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
simstim policy allow api.example.com --repo .
simstim policy allow api.example.com --in box/auth-fix --dry-run
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--all` | the layer for all sessions |
| `--dry-run` | show the rule without writing or sending a mutation |
| `--for <duration>` | keep a session rule for a duration, such as 1h |
| `--host <string>` | a saved host's policy |
| `--in <string>` | the session whose policy to use |
| `--json` | print JSON for scripts, and ask nothing (see docs/how-to/scripting.md) |
| `--once` | allow one matching flow, at session scope |
| `--profile <string>` | a profile in config.toml |
| `--public` | acknowledge that this exact repository push publishes to a public repository |
| `--repo <string>` | a repository origin, or a local folder such as . |
| `--tools <list>` | allow model capabilities for this session: a comma-separated list, or the flag again |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

Part of [`policy`](policy.md): read and change sandbox policy at any layer.
